name: Crypto.com Exchange MCP
description: Real time price quotes, order books, conversions, candlestick charts and more for cryptocurrency tokens from Crypto.com

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Crypto.com Exchange MCP Server - Real-time cryptocurrency market data and interactive widgets.

Available Tools:
- get_widget: Get any interactive widget by name (orderbook, trades, candles)
- get_market_orderbook: Order book snapshot (bids/asks)
- get_market_trades: Recent trade history
- get_market_candles: OHLCV candle data for charting

All tools return structured responses with success/error status and metadata.
Widget can be embedded in ChatGPT or any HTML context.

Example usage:
1. Get widget: get_widget(widget_name='orderbook')
2. Get BTC order book: get_market_orderbook(symbol='BTC_USDT', depth=20)
3. Get ETH trades: get_market_trades(symbol='ETH_USDT', limit=50)
4. Get BTC 4h candles: get_market_candles(symbol='BTC_USDT', interval='4h', limit=100)

_published_faq.name: How do I add Crypto.com Exchange MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Crypto.com Exchange MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.crypto.com/market-data/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Crypto.com Exchange MCP MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Crypto.com Exchange MCP scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Crypto.com Exchange MCP's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Crypto.com Exchange MCP scores 51/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 9 of 9 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Crypto.com Exchange MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crypto.com Exchange MCP provides these MCP tools: get_trades, get_mark_price, get_instruments, get_instrument, get_index_price, Get_candlestick, Get_tickers, Get_ticker, and Get_book.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Crypto.com Exchange MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Crypto.com Exchange MCP in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Crypto.com Exchange MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crypto.com Exchange MCP does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can Crypto.com Exchange MCP improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: get_ticker is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 44/100. 0 of 1 inputs have descriptions. Add descriptions to the missing inputs, including where to obtain IDs and how to supply values. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
